title: Extreme Nash Imbalance on Unequal-Width 4-Mode Mixture
intuition: Combines >600x critic overcapacity and hostile off-manifold initialization with 4 unequal-width Gaussian modes (sigma in {0.07, 0.12, 0.20, 0.30}), testing whether Nash equilibration preserves per-mode scale fidelity.
failure_mode: Even if the generator escapes the initial corner, critic dominance collapses the narrow sigma=0.07 mode or distorts component covariances.
